title: Just Juice Exotic Fruits Cherimoya, Grapefruit & Mixed Berries Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: You may not have heard of cherimoya, but as it’s commonly known as the ‘Ice Cream Fruit’, you get a sense of how delicious this exotic fruit would be in an eliquid. The delicately sweet and creamy fruit is boosted further with tangy grapefruit and juicy, sharp forest berries for a complex yet utterly delicious fruity vape. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette vape starter kits and pod devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
